ValidationRule.description: Other than Assigned user update the status field getting and error.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
ISCHANGED(Status__c),
OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"Not Started"),ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"In Progress"),ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"Completed")) ,
Assigned_To__c <> $User.Id,
NOT( $Permission.In_Progress_or_Complete_Deployment_Tasks_Override )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only the assigned user can mark this Deployment Task as Completed.
